preview_en:
North Macedonia prepare for their UEFA Nations League (UNL) League B debut hoping to harness strong home form against a Switzerland side who haven't travelled well of late.

Match News and Current Form

North Macedonia earned promotion from UNL League C in 2024/25 by going unbeaten (W5, D1), but they’ve struggled to build on that success as they’re currently on a run of eight winless games (D5, L3), conceding a whopping 15 goals across those three defeats! Goce Sedloski’s side have scored just once across their last six games (D3, L3) - and that came in a 7-1 loss to Wales - but their form in Skopje has been a different story, with their unbeaten sequence at home now stretching to an impressive 11 matches (W5, D6). That includes draws against Belgium, England, and Italy, which should give the Lynxes hope of making an impact in this campaign.

Switzerland were relegated from League A in 2024/25 (D2, L4), and while their run to the World Cup quarter-finals should have seen them coming into this on a high, their preparations have been disrupted by Granit Xhaka’s withdrawal after he admitted obtaining a fake COVID-19 vaccination certificate. Head coach Murat Yakin therefore has a midfield rebuild on his hands as he attempts to extend their run of not losing a game inside 90 minutes since March (W4, D5), and the Red Crosses have proven hard to beat on the road, going unbeaten across their last seven games played on their opponents’ home soil (W3, D4).

Head-to-Head History

These two sides have never previously met.

Hot Stats and Streaks

None of North Macedonia’s last nine fixtures produced more goals before half-time than after.

North Macedonia scored exactly once in five of their last six competitive home matches.

Two of Switzerland’s last three games produced a goal in the tenth minute.

Five of Switzerland’s last six UNL games produced under 10.5 corners.

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Jani Atanasov has collected yellow cards in both of his last two club appearances and produced two goal contributions (G1, A1) during North Macedonia’s previous UNL campaign. Johan Manzambi , a star of Switzerland’s World Cup campaign, scored and assisted for Aston Villa at the weekend, while three of his last five international strikes came after the 85th minute.

North Macedonia are without Darko Churlinov due to an administrative issue, while Nikola Serafimov is injured. Breel Embolo is suspended for Switzerland after his red card against Argentina in the World Cup quarter-final, while Rubén Vargas and Denis Zakaria are among those absent through injury.

For all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre.

Betting Analysis

Xhaka is a major absence for Switzerland, but they ought to be too strong for goal-shy North Macedonia, suggesting backing the visitors to win by at least two goals could be worth a shot.

Author: John Pennington
